Chapter 3

Interacting with Kubernetes与 Kubernetes 交互

As an application developer, you will want to interact with the Kubernetes cluster to manage objects that operate your application. Every call to the cluster is accepted and processed by the API server component. There are various ways to perform a call to the API server. For example, you can use a web-based dashboard, a command-line tool like kubectl, or a direct HTTPS request to the RESTful API endpoints.

作为应用开发者，你会希望与 Kubernetes 集群交互，以管理运行你应用的各种对象。对集群的每一次调用都由 API server 组件接收并处理。调用 API server 有多种方式：例如基于 Web 的控制台、像 kubectl 这样的命令行工具，或者直接向 RESTful API 端点发起 HTTPS 请求。

The exam does not test the use of a visual user interface for interacting with the Kubernetes cluster. Your only client for solving exam questions is kubectl. This chapter will touch on the Kubernetes API primitives and objects, as well as the different ways to manage objects with kubectl.

考试不考查使用图形用户界面与 Kubernetes 集群交互。你解答考题时唯一的客户端就是 kubectl。本章将介绍 Kubernetes API 原语与对象，以及用 kubectl 管理对象的不同方式。

API Primitives and ObjectsAPI 原语与对象

Kubernetes primitives are the basic building blocks anchored in the Kubernetes architecture for creating and operating an application on the platform. Even as a beginner to Kubernetes, you might have heard of the terms Pod, Deployment, and Service, all of which are Kubernetes primitives. There are many more that serve a dedicated purpose in the Kubernetes architecture.

Kubernetes 原语是植根于 Kubernetes 架构中的基本构建块，用于在该平台上创建和运行应用。即便你是 Kubernetes 初学者，也可能听说过 Pod、Deployment、Service 这些术语——它们都是 Kubernetes 原语。在 Kubernetes 架构中，还有许多各司其职的原语。

To draw an analogy, think back to the concepts of object-oriented programming. In object-oriented programming languages, a class defines the blueprint of a real-world functionality: its properties and behavior. A Kubernetes primitive is the equivalent of a class. The instance of a class in object-oriented programming is an object, managing its own state and having the ability to communicate with other parts of the system. Whenever you create a Kubernetes object, you produce such an instance.

打个比方，回想一下面向对象编程的概念。在面向对象编程语言中，类定义了一项现实功能的蓝图：它的属性和行为。Kubernetes 原语就相当于一个类。面向对象编程中类的实例就是对象，它管理自己的状态，并能与系统的其他部分通信。每当你创建一个 Kubernetes 对象，就是产生了这样一个实例。

For example, a Pod in Kubernetes is the class of which there can be many instances with their own identity. Every Kubernetes object has a system-generated unique identifier (also known as UID) to clearly distinguish between the entities of a system.

例如，Kubernetes 中的 Pod 是一个“类”，它可以有许多各自拥有身份的实例。每个 Kubernetes 对象都有一个系统生成的唯一标识符（也称 UID），用以明确区分系统中的各个实体。

— PDF p.43 —

Later, we’ll look at the properties of a Kubernetes object. Figure 3-1 illustrates the relationship between a Kubernetes primitive and an object.

稍后我们会看 Kubernetes 对象的属性。图 3-1 展示了 Kubernetes 原语与对象之间的关系。

Every Kubernetes primitive follows a general structure, which you can observe if you look deeper at a manifest of an object, as shown in Figure 3-2. The primary markup language used for a Kubernetes manifest is YAML.

每个 Kubernetes 原语都遵循一个通用结构，深入查看某个对象的 manifest 就能看到，如图 3-2 所示。Kubernetes manifest 主要使用的标记语言是 YAML。

Let’s look at each section and its relevance within the Kubernetes system:

我们逐节看一下各部分及其在 Kubernetes 系统中的作用：

  • API version: The Kubernetes API version defines the structure of a primitive and uses it to validate the correctness of the data. The API version serves a similar purpose as XML schemas to an XML document or JSON schemas to a JSON document. The version usually undergoes a maturity process—for example, from alpha to beta to final. Sometimes you see different prefixes separated by a slash (e.g., apps). You can list the API versions compatible with your cluster version by running the command kubectl api-versions.API version（API 版本）：Kubernetes API 版本定义了一个原语的结构，并用它来校验数据的正确性。API 版本的作用类似于 XML schema 之于 XML 文档、或 JSON schema 之于 JSON 文档。版本通常会经历一个成熟过程——例如从 alpha 到 beta 再到 final。有时你会看到用斜杠分隔的不同前缀（例如 apps）。运行 kubectl api-versions 命令可以列出与你的集群版本兼容的 API 版本。
— PDF p.44 —
  • Kind: The kind defines the type of primitive—e.g., a Pod or a Service. It ultimately answers the question, “What kind of resource are we dealing with here?”Kind（种类）：kind 定义了原语的类型——例如 Pod 或 Service。它最终回答的是：“我们在这里面对的是哪一种资源？”
  • Metadata: Metadata describes higher-level information about the object—e.g., its name, what namespace it lives in, or whether it defines labels and annotations. This section also defines the UID.Metadata（元数据）：元数据描述关于对象的高层信息——例如它的名字、位于哪个 namespace，或是否定义了 label 和 annotation。这一部分还定义了 UID。
  • Spec: The specification (spec for short) declares the desired state—e.g., how should this object look after it has been created? Which image should run in the container, or which environment variables should be set?Spec（规约）：specification（简称 spec）声明期望状态——例如这个对象创建后应该是什么样子？容器里该运行哪个镜像，或该设置哪些环境变量？
  • Status: The status describes the actual state of an object. The Kubernetes controllers and their reconciliation loops constantly try to transition a Kubernetes object from the actual state into the desired state. The object has not yet been materialized if the YAML status shows the value {}.Status（状态）：status 描述对象的实际状态。Kubernetes 控制器及其调和循环不断努力把一个 Kubernetes 对象从实际状态迁移到期望状态。如果 YAML 中的 status 显示为 {}，说明该对象尚未被物化。

With this basic structure in mind, let’s look at how to create a Kubernetes object with the help of kubectl.

了解了这个基本结构后，我们来看看如何借助 kubectl 创建 Kubernetes 对象。

Using kubectl使用 kubectl

kubectl is the primary tool for interacting with the Kubernetes clusters from the command line. The exam is exclusively focused on the use of kubectl. Therefore, it’s paramount to understand its ins and outs and practice its use heavily.

kubectl 是从命令行与 Kubernetes 集群交互的主要工具。考试只考查 kubectl 的使用。因此，透彻理解它的方方面面并大量练习，至关重要。

This section provides you with a brief overview of its typical usage pattern. Let’s start by looking at the syntax for running commands. A kubectl execution consists of a command, a resource type, a resource name, and optional command line flags:

本节简要介绍它的典型用法。先看运行命令的语法。一次 kubectl 执行由命令、资源类型、资源名和可选的命令行 flags 组成：

$ kubectl [command] [TYPE] [NAME] [flags]

The command specifies the operation you’re planning to run. Typical commands are verbs like create, get, describe, or delete. Next, you’ll need to provide the resource type you’re working on, either as a full resource type or its short form. For example, you could work on a service here or use the short form, svc.

command 指定你打算执行的操作。典型命令是 create、get、describe、delete 这样的动词。接着需要提供你要操作的资源类型，可以写全称或简写形式。例如这里可以操作 service，或用简写 svc。

The name of the resource identifies the user-facing object identifier, effectively the value of metadata.name in the YAML representation. Be aware that the object name is not the same as the UID. The UID is an autogenerated, Kubernetes-internal object reference that you usually don’t have to interact with. The name of an object has to be unique across all objects of the same resource type within a namespace.

资源名标识面向用户的对象标识符，实际上就是 YAML 表示中 metadata.name 的值。请注意对象名与 UID 不同。UID 是 Kubernetes 内部自动生成的对象引用，你通常无需与之打交道。在一个 namespace 内，同一资源类型的所有对象之间，对象名必须唯一。

— PDF p.45 —

Finally, you can provide zero to many command-line flags to describe additional configuration behavior. A typical example of a command-line flag is the --port flag, which exposes a Pod’s container port.

最后，你可以提供零个或多个命令行 flags 来描述额外的配置行为。一个典型的 flag 例子是 --port，用来暴露 Pod 的容器端口。

Figure 3-3 shows a full kubectl command in action.

图 3-3 展示了一条完整 kubectl 命令的实际用法。

Over the course of this book, we’ll explore the kubectl commands that will make you the most productive during the exam. There are many more, however, and they usually go beyond the ones you’d use on a day-to-day basis as an application developer. Next up, we’ll have a deeper look at the create command, the imperative way to create a Kubernetes object. We’ll also compare the imperative object creation approach with the declarative approach.

在本书中，我们将探讨那些能让你在考试中最高效的 kubectl 命令。命令远不止这些，而且通常超出你作为应用开发者日常会用到的范围。接下来我们深入看 create 命令——创建 Kubernetes 对象的命令式方式。我们还会把命令式对象创建与声明式方式做比较。

A crucial time-saving tool during the exam is kubectl explain, which provides instant access to resource specifications without needing to search documentation. For example, kubectl explain pods.spec.containers shows all available container configuration fields, while kubectl explain deployment.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate details rolling update parameters. This command is particularly valuable when you need to quickly verify field names, check if a property is a list or single value, or understand nested structures—use it liberally to avoid typos and save precious minutes that would otherwise be spent searching through Kubernetes documentation.

考试中一个关键的省时工具是 kubectl explain，它让你无需翻文档就能即时查阅资源规约。例如，kubectl explain pods.spec.containers 会列出所有可用的容器配置字段，而 kubectl explain deployment.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate 会详述滚动更新参数。当你需要快速核对字段名、判断某个属性是列表还是单值、或理解嵌套结构时，这条命令尤其有价值——大胆使用它，避免拼写错误，省下宝贵的几分钟（否则你得花在翻 Kubernetes 文档上）。

Managing Objects管理对象

You can create objects in a Kubernetes cluster in two ways: imperatively or declaratively. The following sections describe each approach, including their benefits, drawbacks, and use cases.

在 Kubernetes 集群中创建对象有两种方式：命令式或声明式。接下来的小节分别介绍这两种方式，包括它们的优点、缺点和适用场景。

Imperative Object Management命令式对象管理

Imperative object management does not require a manifest definition. You’ll use kubectl to drive the creation, modification, and deletion of objects with a single command and one or many command-line options. See the Kubernetes documentation for a more detailed description of imperative object management.

命令式对象管理不需要 manifest 定义。你用 kubectl 通过一条命令加一个或多个命令行选项来驱动对象的创建、修改和删除。命令式对象管理的更详细描述见 Kubernetes 文档。

— PDF p.46 —

Creating objects

创建对象

Use the run or create command to create an object on the fly. Any configuration needed at runtime is provided by command-line options. The benefit of this approach is the fast turnaround time without the need to wrestle with YAML structures. The following run command creates a Pod named frontend that executes the container image nginx:1.29.0 in a container with the exposed port 80:

使用 run 或 create 命令即时创建对象。运行时所需的任何配置都由命令行选项提供。这种方式的好处是周转快，无需折腾 YAML 结构。下面的 run 命令创建一个名为 frontend 的 Pod，在容器中运行镜像 nginx:1.29.0，并暴露端口 80：

$ kubectl run frontend --image=nginx:1.29.0 --port=80
pod/frontend created

Updating objects

更新对象

The configuration of live objects can still be modified. kubectl supports this use case by providing the edit and patch commands.

运行中对象的配置仍然可以修改。kubectl 通过提供 edit 和 patch 命令来支持这一场景。

The edit command opens an editor with the raw configuration of the live object. Changes to the configuration will be applied to the live object after exiting the editor. The command will open the editor defined by the KUBE_EDITOR, or EDITOR environment variables, or fall back to vi for Linux or notepad for Windows. This command demonstrates the use of the edit command for the Pod live object named frontend:

edit 命令会用编辑器打开运行中对象的原始配置。退出编辑器后，对配置的改动会应用到该运行中对象上。该命令会打开由 KUBE_EDITOR 或 EDITOR 环境变量定义的编辑器；若未定义，则 Linux 下回退到 vi，Windows 下回退到 notepad。下面的命令演示如何对名为 frontend 的 Pod 运行中对象使用 edit：

$ kubectl edit pod frontend

The patch command allows for fine-grained modification of a live object on an attribute level using a JSON merge patch. The following example illustrates the use of patch command to update the container image tag assigned to the Pod created earlier. The -p flag defines the JSON structure used to modify the live object:

patch 命令允许使用 JSON merge patch，在属性级别对运行中对象做细粒度修改。下面的例子演示如何用 patch 命令更新先前创建的 Pod 所使用的容器镜像标签。-p flag 定义了用于修改运行中对象的 JSON 结构：

$ kubectl patch pod frontend -p '{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"frontend",
"image":"nginx:1.29.2"}]}}'
pod/frontend patched

Deleting objects

删除对象

You can delete a Kubernetes object at any time. During the exam, the need may arise if you made a mistake while solving a problem and want to start from scratch to ensure a clean slate. In a production Kubernetes environment, you’ll want to delete objects that are no longer needed. The following delete command deletes the Pod object by its name frontend:

你可以随时删除 Kubernetes 对象。考试时，如果你做题犯了错、想从头开始以确保干净状态，就可能需要删除对象。在生产 Kubernetes 环境中，你会想删除不再需要的对象。下面的 delete 命令按名字 frontend 删除该 Pod 对象：

$ kubectl delete pod frontend
pod "frontend" deleted

Upon execution of the delete command, Kubernetes tries to delete the targeted object gracefully so that there’s minimal impact on the end user. If the object cannot be deleted within the default grace period (30 seconds), the kubelet attempts to forcefully terminate the object.

执行 delete 命令后，Kubernetes 会尝试优雅地删除目标对象，把对最终用户的影响降到最低。如果在默认宽限期（30 秒）内无法删除该对象，kubelet 会尝试强制终止它。

— PDF p.47 —

During the exam, end-user impact is not a concern. The most important goal is to complete all tasks in the time granted to the candidate. Therefore, waiting on an object to be deleted gracefully is a waste of time. You can force an immediate deletion of an object with the command-line option --now. The following command terminates the Pod named nginx using a SIGKILL signal:

考试时，你不必担心对最终用户的影响。最重要的目标是在规定时间内完成所有任务。因此，等待对象被优雅删除是浪费时间。你可以用命令行选项 --now 强制立即删除对象。下面的命令用 SIGKILL 信号终止名为 nginx 的 Pod：

$ kubectl delete pod nginx --now

Declarative Object Management声明式对象管理

Declarative object management requires one or several manifests in the format of YAML or JSON describing the desired state of an object. You create, update, and delete objects using this approach.

声明式对象管理需要一个或多个 YAML 或 JSON 格式的 manifest，描述对象的期望状态。你用这种方式来创建、更新和删除对象。

The benefit of using the declarative method is reproducibility and improved maintenance, as the file is checked into version control in most cases. The declarative approach is the recommended way to create objects in production environments. More information on declarative object management can be found in the Kubernetes documentation.

使用声明式方法的好处是可复现性和更好的可维护性——因为这些文件在大多数情况下会被纳入版本控制。声明式方式是生产环境中创建对象的推荐做法。声明式对象管理的更多信息见 Kubernetes 文档。

Creating objects

创建对象

The declarative approach creates objects from a manifest (in most cases, a YAML file) using the apply command. The command works by pointing to a file, a directory of files, or a file referenced by an HTTP(S) URL using the -f option. If one or more of the objects already exist, the command will synchronize the changes made to the configuration with the live object.

声明式方式使用 apply 命令，从 manifest（多数情况下是一个 YAML 文件）创建对象。该命令通过 -f 选项指向一个文件、一个文件目录、或一个由 HTTP(S) URL 引用的文件来工作。如果其中一个或多个对象已存在，该命令会把配置上的改动与运行中对象同步。

To demonstrate this functionality, we’ll assume the following directories and configuration files. The following commands create objects from a single file, from all files within a directory, and from all files in a directory recursively. Refer to files in the book’s GitHub repository if you want to give it a try. Later chapters will explain the purpose of the primitives used here:

为演示这一功能，我们假设有下面的目录结构和配置文件。后续命令分别演示：从单个文件创建、从某个目录下所有文件创建、以及递归地从某目录树下所有文件创建。如果你想动手尝试，可参考本书 GitHub 仓库中的文件。后续章节会解释这里用到的原语的用途：

.
├── app-stack
│   ├── mysql-pod.yaml
│   ├── mysql-service.yaml
│   ├── web-app-pod.yaml
│   └── web-app-service.yaml
├── nginx-deployment.yaml
└── web-app
    ├── config
    │   ├── db-configmap.yaml
    │   └── db-secret.yaml
    └── web-app-pod.yaml
— PDF p.48 —

Creating an object from a single file:

从单个文件创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f nginx-deployment.yaml
deployment.apps/nginx-deployment created

Creating objects from multiple files within a directory:

从某个目录下的多个文件创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f app-stack/
pod/mysql-db created
service/mysql-service created
pod/web-app created
service/web-app-service created

Creating objects from a recursive directory tree containing files:

从包含文件的递归目录树创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f web-app/ -R
configmap/db-config configured
secret/db-creds created
pod/web-app created

Creating objects from a file referenced by an HTTP(S) URL:

从 HTTP(S) URL 引用的文件创建对象：

$ kubectl apply -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bmuschko/
cka-study-guide/master/ch03/object-management/nginx-deployment.yaml
deployment.apps/nginx-deployment created

The apply command keeps track of the changes by adding or modifying the annotation with the key kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration. Here’s an example of the annotation in the output of the get pod command:

apply 命令通过添加或修改键为 kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration 的 annotation 来跟踪变更。下面是 get pod 命令输出中该 annotation 的例子：

$ kubectl get pod web-app -o yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"Pod","metadata":{"annotations":{},
      "labels":{"app":"web-app"},"name":"web-app","namespace":"default"},
      "spec":{"containers":[{"envFrom":[{"configMapRef":{"name":"db-config"}},
      {"secretRef":{"name":"db-creds"}}],"image":"bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1",
      "name":"web-app","ports":[{"containerPort":3000,"protocol":"TCP"}]}],
      "restartPolicy":"Always"}}
...

Updating objects

更新对象

Updating an existing object is done with the same apply command. All you need to do is to change the configuration file and then run the command against it.

更新现有对象同样使用 apply 命令。你只需修改配置文件，再对它运行该命令即可。

— PDF p.49 —
kubectl create versus kubectl apply commandkubectl create 与 kubectl apply 命令对比

The kubectl create command is used to create new Kubernetes resources and will fail if the resource already exists, making it suitable for one-time resource creation. In contrast, kubectl apply uses a declarative approach that can both create new resources and update existing ones by comparing the desired state in your YAML/JSON file with the current state in the cluster, making it idempotent and ideal for managing resources over time.

kubectl create 命令用于创建新的 Kubernetes 资源；如果资源已存在就会失败，因此适合一次性创建资源。相比之下，kubectl apply 采用声明式方式：通过把 YAML/JSON 文件中的期望状态与集群中的当前状态做比较，既能创建新资源，也能更新现有资源，因此是幂等的，非常适合长期管理资源。

Example 3-1 modifies the existing configuration of a Deployment in the file nginx-deployment.yaml. I added a new label with the key team and changed the number of replicas from three to five.

例 3-1 修改了 nginx-deployment.yaml 文件中某个 Deployment 的现有配置。我新增了一个键为 team 的 label，并把 replicas 数量从 3 改成 5。

Example 3-1. Modified configuration file for a Deployment

例 3-1. 修改后的 Deployment 配置文件

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-deployment
  labels:
    app: nginx
    team: red
spec:
  replicas: 5
...

The following command applies the changed configuration file. As a result, the number of Pods controlled by the underlying ReplicaSet is five:

下面的命令应用修改后的配置文件。结果是：底层 ReplicaSet 所控制的 Pod 数量变为 5：

$ kubectl apply -f nginx-deployment.yaml
deployment.apps/nginx-deployment configured

The Deployment’s kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration annotation reflects the latest change to the configuration:

该 Deployment 的 kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration annotation 反映了配置的最新改动：

$ kubectl get deployment nginx-deployment -o yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: |
      {"apiVersion":"apps/v1","kind":"Deployment","metadata":{"annotations":{},
      "labels":{"app":"nginx","team":"red"},"name":"nginx-deployment",
      "namespace":"default"},"spec":{"replicas":5,"selector":{"matchLabels":
      {"app":"nginx"}},"template":{"metadata":{"labels":{"app":"nginx"}},
      "spec":{"containers":[{"image":"nginx:1.14.2","name":"nginx",
      "ports":[{"containerPort":80}]}]}}}}
...
— PDF p.50 —

Deleting objects

删除对象

While you can delete objects using the apply command by providing the options --prune -l <labels>, it is recommended to delete an object using the delete command and point it to the configuration file. The following command deletes a Deployment and the objects it controls (ReplicaSet and Pods):

虽然你可以用 apply 命令并带上 --prune -l <labels> 选项来删除对象，但更推荐用 delete 命令并指向配置文件来删除对象。下面的命令删除一个 Deployment 及其所控制的对象（ReplicaSet 和 Pod）：

$ kubectl delete -f nginx-deployment.yaml
deployment.apps "nginx-deployment" deleted

When you delete a Pod that’s managed by a ReplicaSet or Deployment, the controller will automatically recreate it to maintain the desired replica count, making the deletion temporary and ineffective. Therefore, you should only modify or delete the resources you directly created (like the Deployment itself), rather than attempting to change the state of objects that are indirectly managed by controllers (like individual Pods created by that Deployment). This ensures your changes are permanent and aligns with Kubernetes’ declarative model where controllers continuously reconcile the actual state with the desired state.

当你删除一个由 ReplicaSet 或 Deployment 管理的 Pod 时，控制器会自动重建它以维持期望的副本数，使得这次删除只是暂时的、无效的。因此，你应当只修改或删除自己直接创建的资源（如 Deployment 本身），而不要试图去改变那些由控制器间接管理的对象（如该 Deployment 创建的单个 Pod）的状态。这能确保你的改动是持久的，也符合 Kubernetes 的声明式模型——控制器会不断把实际状态调和到期望状态。

You can use the --now option to forcefully delete Pods, as described in “Deleting objects” on page 25.

你可以使用 --now 选项强制删除 Pod，如第 25 页“Deleting objects”所述。

Hybrid Approach混合方式

Sometimes you may want to go with a hybrid approach. You can start by using the imperative method to produce a manifest file without actually creating an object. You do so by executing the run or create command with the command-line options -o yaml and --dry-run=client:

有时你可能想用混合方式。你可以先用命令式方法生成一个 manifest 文件，而并不真正创建对象。做法是执行 run 或 create 命令，并带上 -o yaml 和 --dry-run=client 命令行选项：

$ kubectl run frontend --image=nginx:1.29.2 --port=80 \
  -o yaml --dry-run=client > pod.yaml

You can now use the generate YAML manifest as a starting point to make further modifications before creating the object. Simply open the file with an editor, change the content, and execute the declarative apply command:

现在你可以把生成的 YAML manifest 作为起点，在创建对象之前做进一步修改。只需用编辑器打开文件、修改内容，然后执行声明式的 apply 命令：

$ vim pod.yaml
$ kubectl apply -f pod.yaml
pod/frontend created

Which Approach to Use?该用哪种方式？

During the exam, using imperative commands is the most efficient and quickest way to manage objects. Not all configuration options are exposed through command-line flags, which may force you into using the declarative approach. The hybrid approach can help here.

考试期间，使用命令式命令是管理对象最高效、最快捷的方式。但并非所有配置项都通过命令行 flags 暴露，这可能迫使你使用声明式方式。这时混合方式就能帮上忙。

— PDF p.51 —
GitOps and KubernetesGitOps 与 Kubernetes

GitOps is a practice that leverages source code checked into Git repositories to automate infrastructure management, specifically in cloud native environments powered by Kubernetes. Tools such as Argo CD and Flux implement GitOps principles to deploy applications to Kubernetes through a declarative approach. Teams responsible for overseeing real-world Kubernetes clusters and the applications within them are highly likely to adopt the declarative approach.

GitOps 是一种实践：利用提交到 Git 仓库的源代码来自动化基础设施管理，尤其适用于由 Kubernetes 驱动的云原生环境。Argo CD、Flux 之类的工具实现 GitOps 原则，通过声明式方式把应用部署到 Kubernetes 上。那些负责看管真实 Kubernetes 集群及其内应用的团队，极有可能采用声明式方式。

While creating objects imperatively can optimize the turnaround time, in a real-world Kubernetes environment you’ll most certainly want to use the declarative approach. A YAML manifest file represents the ultimate source of truth of a Kubernetes object. Version-controlled files can be audited and shared, and they store a history of changes in case you need to revert to a previous revision.

虽然命令式创建对象能优化周转时间，但在真实 Kubernetes 环境中，你几乎肯定会想用声明式方式。YAML manifest 文件代表了一个 Kubernetes 对象的最终事实来源。纳入版本控制的文件可被审计和共享，还保存了变更历史，以便你需要回退到先前版本时使用。

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes represents its functionality for deploying and operating a cloud native application with the help of primitives. Each primitive follows a general structure: the API version, the kind, the metadata, and the desired state of the resources, also called the spec. Upon creation or modification of the object, the Kubernetes scheduler automatically tries to ensure that the actual state of the object follows the defined specification. Every live object can be inspected, edited, and deleted.

Kubernetes 借助原语来表达其部署和运行云原生应用的功能。每个原语都遵循一个通用结构：API 版本、kind、元数据，以及资源的期望状态（也叫 spec）。在创建或修改对象时，Kubernetes 调度器会自动努力确保对象的实际状态遵循所定义的规约。每个运行中的对象都可以被查看、编辑和删除。

kubectl acts as a CLI-based client to interact with the Kubernetes cluster. You can use its commands and flags to manage Kubernetes objects. The imperative approach provides a fast turnaround time for managing objects with a single command, as long as you memorize the available flags. More complex configuration calls for the use of a YAML manifest to define a primitive. Use the declarative command to instantiate objects from that definition. The YAML manifest is usually checked into version control and offers a way to track changes to the configuration.

kubectl 充当基于 CLI 的客户端，与 Kubernetes 集群交互。你可以用它的命令和 flags 来管理 Kubernetes 对象。只要你记住了可用的 flags，命令式方式就能用一条命令快速管理对象。更复杂的配置则需要用 YAML manifest 来定义原语，再用声明式命令从该定义实例化对象。YAML manifest 通常会被纳入版本控制，提供了跟踪配置变更的途径。
